_readme: Company statuses that no automated source can establish.
backfill-org-status.js derives `public` from the SEC ticker file, which is a
primary document and needs no human. It refuses to write `acquired` or
`defunct`, because EDGAR records that a company stopped filing, not why: an
acquisition and a bankruptcy look identical in a filing history. Those two
values are written here instead, one company at a time, each with the filing
`source_url` must be a primary document, normally the 8-K reporting the
event. `effective_date` is the date of the event the filing reports, not the
date the filing was made. Nothing here is written from memory.
Applied by scripts/backfill-org-status.js, which is idempotent.

Axonics Modulation Technologies.note: 8-K: merger with Boston Scientific Corporation completed 15 Nov 2024 under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated 8 Jan 2024. Axonics filed Form 25-NSE the same day and Form 15-12G on 25 Nov 2024.

Pear Therapeutics.note: 8-K Item 1.03 Bankruptcy or Receivership: voluntary chapter 11 petition filed 7 Apr 2023 by Pear Therapeutics, Inc. and Pear Therapeutics (US), Inc. Form 25-NSE followed on 2 May 2023.
Pear Therapeutics.listing_note: Class A common stock traded on Nasdaq as PEAR, and warrants as PEARW, per the cover page of the 8-K above. The registrant is the former Thimble Point Acquisition Corp. Its private-only total is therefore partial, and the chart marks it.
